note: Formula test, not a render test. Locks the backdrop slot: both what its two occupants look like, and how it changes between them. Both engines implement it as fragment shaders (src/shaders/fluid_background.frag here, phonoscope_fluid_background in PhonoscopeShader.metal). The band half covers where the centred band sits at a given height and width, the one-pixel softening of its clip edge, the four PhonoscopeEdgeVignette gradients and the source-over product that combines them, the vignetteSize scaling that keeps the 0.18/0.28 ratio, and the rule that outside the band is solid vignette colour rather than a hole. The transition half covers which changes swap a single plane at the midpoint and which cross-dissolve (field <-> image is always a dissolve, because a field has no rectangle to flip or slide), the dissolve of the two finished framed pictures, and the source-over of an image plane onto the theme backdrop -- see specs/backdrop-transitions.md. The blob field itself is not locked -- it is stood in for by a flat fieldColor, because drift in the field reads as a different picture rather than a different layout. The grid is defined in runBackgroundBandCase() and mirrored by ParitySelfTests.testBackgroundBandParity(); changing either means changing both and re-recording expected.json.
